integrity: The proof is self-contained from standard Hilbert C*-module identities and finite-dimensional rank/singular-value facts. No computational experiment is used as an infinite or exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: The universal statement is a sharp two-sided bound, not an equality theorem for arbitrary imprimitivity bimodules. Exact frame length from localization distortion is proved only for rectangular matrix Morita modules. Unbounded traces are excluded.
title: Trace localization controls finite module-frame rank, exactly for rectangular matrix Morita modules
